# NBC Chicago

> > NBC Chicago delivers local Chicago news, weather forecasts, breaking alerts, and Olympic sports coverage for the Chicagoland area.

NBC Chicago (NBC 5) is the local NBC affiliate serving Chicago and surrounding communities with comprehensive news coverage, severe weather tracking, traffic updates, and special coverage of major events including the Olympics. The station features reporting on Chicago neighborhoods, O'Hare Airport updates, local events like St. Patrick's Day celebrations, and exclusive Olympic content featuring figure skating stars like Amber Glenn, alongside commentary from Johnny Weir and Terry Gannon.

## Key Topics

- Chicago local news
- Weather forecasts and alerts
- Breaking news coverage
- 2026 Milan Cortina Olympics
- Figure skating (Amber Glenn, Mariah Bell, Alysa Liu, Ilia Malinin)
- O'Hare Airport updates
- Chicago events and festivals
- St. Patrick's Day celebrations
- Olympic sports commentary (Johnny Weir, Terry Gannon)
- Peacock streaming coverage
- Chicago neighborhoods
- Traffic and transportation
- NBCUniversal Media content
